name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 102 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 23% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 102 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 23 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces continue demolishing homes of Palestinians accused of attacks in the West Bank, while settlers attacked Palestinian olive harvesters, wounding three. In Gaza, at least four Palestinians were killed as Israeli attacks persisted and children faced deadly risks on their way to school. The UN rights office warned of a deepening displacement nightmare in Gaza and called for an urgent UN protection force to be deployed to Palestine. Rare footage of Mohammed Deif and previously unseen videos of Hamas commanders who have since been killed by Israel were released, adding new visual evidence to the conflict.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker fortsetter å rive ned hjemmene til palestinere som er anklaget for angrep på Vestbredden, mens bosettere angrep palestinske olivenplukkere og såret tre. I Gaza ble minst fire palestinere drept mens israelske angrep vedvarte og barn møtte dødelige farer på vei til skolen. FN-s menneskerettighetskontor advarte om en dypere fordrivelsesmareritt i Gaza og oppfordret til at en hastig FN-beskyttelsesstyrke ble utplassert i Palestina. Sjeldne opptak av Mohammed Deif og tidligere usette videoer av Hamas-kommandanter som siden er drept av Israel ble publisert, og gir nye visuelle bevis på konflikten.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
